verses.name: Romans 6:1
verses.text: What shall we say then? Shall we continue in sin, that grace may abound?

verses.name: Romans 6:2
verses.text: God forbid. How shall we, that are dead to sin, live any longer therein?

verses.name: Romans 6:3
verses.text: Know ye not, that so many of us as were baptized into Jesus Christ were baptized into his death?

verses.name: Romans 6:4
verses.text: Therefore we are buried with him by baptism into death: that like as Christ was raised up from the dead by the glory of the Father, even so we also should walk in newness of life.

verses.name: Romans 6:5
verses.text: For if we have been planted together in the likeness of his death, we shall be also in the likeness of his resurrection:

verses.name: Romans 6:6
verses.text: Knowing this, that our old man is crucified with him, that the body of sin might be destroyed, that henceforth we should not serve sin.

verses.name: Romans 6:7
verses.text: For he that is dead is freed from sin.

verses.name: Romans 6:8
verses.text: Now if we be dead with Christ, we believe that we shall also live with him:

verses.name: Romans 6:9
verses.text: Knowing that Christ being raised from the dead dieth no more; death hath no more dominion over him.

verses.name: Romans 6:10
verses.text: For in that he died, he died unto sin once: but in that he liveth, he liveth unto God.

verses.name: Romans 6:11
verses.text: Likewise reckon ye also yourselves to be dead indeed unto sin, but alive unto God through Jesus Christ our Lord.

verses.name: Romans 6:12
verses.text: Let not sin therefore reign in your mortal body, that ye should obey it in the lusts thereof.

verses.name: Romans 6:13
verses.text: Neither yield ye your members as instruments of unrighteousness unto sin: but yield yourselves unto God, as those that are alive from the dead, and your members as instruments of righteousness unto God.

verses.name: Romans 6:14
verses.text: For sin shall not have dominion over you: for ye are not under the law, but under grace.

verses.name: Romans 6:15
verses.text: What then? shall we sin, because we are not under the law, but under grace? God forbid.

verses.name: Romans 6:16
verses.text: Know ye not, that to whom ye yield yourselves servants to obey, his servants ye are to whom ye obey; whether of sin unto death, or of obedience unto righteousness?

verses.name: Romans 6:17
verses.text: But God be thanked, that ye were the servants of sin, but ye have obeyed from the heart that form of doctrine which was delivered you.

verses.name: Romans 6:18
verses.text: Being then made free from sin, ye became the servants of righteousness.

verses.name: Romans 6:19
verses.text: I speak after the manner of men because of the infirmity of your flesh: for as ye have yielded your members servants to uncleanness and to iniquity unto iniquity; even so now yield your members servants to righteousness unto holiness.

verses.name: Romans 6:20
verses.text: For when ye were the servants of sin, ye were free from righteousness.

verses.name: Romans 6:21
verses.text: What fruit had ye then in those things whereof ye are now ashamed? for the end of those things is death.

verses.name: Romans 6:22
verses.text: But now being made free from sin, and become servants to God, ye have your fruit unto holiness, and the end everlasting life.

verses.name: Romans 6:23
verses.text: For the wages of sin is death; but the gift of God is eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.

verses.name: Hebrews 1:1
verses.text: God, who at sundry times and in divers manners spake in time past unto the fathers by the prophets,

verses.name: Hebrews 1:2
verses.text: Hath in these last days spoken unto us by his Son, whom he hath appointed heir of all things, by whom also he made the worlds;

verses.name: Hebrews 1:3
verses.text: Who being the brightness of his glory, and the express image of his person, and upholding all things by the word of his power, when he had by himself purged our sins, sat down on the right hand of the Majesty on high;

verses.name: Hebrews 1:4
verses.text: Being made so much better than the angels, as he hath by inheritance obtained a more excellent name than they.

verses.name: Hebrews 1:5
verses.text: For unto which of the angels said he at any time, Thou art my Son, this day have I begotten thee? And again, I will be to him a Father, and he shall be to me a Son?

verses.name: Hebrews 1:6
verses.text: And again, when he bringeth in the firstbegotten into the world, he saith, And let all the angels of God worship him.

verses.name: Hebrews 1:7
verses.text: And of the angels he saith, Who maketh his angels spirits, and his ministers a flame of fire.

verses.name: Hebrews 1:8
verses.text: But unto the Son he saith, Thy throne, O God, is for ever and ever: a sceptre of righteousness is the sceptre of thy kingdom.

verses.name: Hebrews 1:9
verses.text: Thou hast loved righteousness, and hated iniquity; therefore God, even thy God, hath anointed thee with the oil of gladness above thy fellows.

verses.name: Hebrews 1:10
verses.text: And, Thou, Lord, in the beginning hast laid the foundation of the earth; and the heavens are the works of thine hands:

verses.name: Hebrews 1:11
verses.text: They shall perish; but thou remainest; and they all shall wax old as doth a garment;

verses.name: Hebrews 1:12
verses.text: And as a vesture shalt thou fold them up, and they shall be changed: but thou art the same, and thy years shall not fail.

verses.name: Hebrews 1:13
verses.text: But to which of the angels said he at any time, Sit on my right hand, until I make thine enemies thy footstool?

verses.name: Hebrews 1:14
verses.text: Are they not all ministering spirits, sent forth to minister for them who shall be heirs of salvation?

verses.name: Евреям 1:1
verses.text: Бог, многократно и многообразно говоривший издревле отцам в пророках,

verses.name: Евреям 1:2
verses.text: в последние дни сии говорил нам в Сыне, Которого поставил наследником всего, чрез Которого и веки сотворил.

verses.name: Евреям 1:3
verses.text: Сей, будучи сияние славы и образ ипостаси Его и держа все словом силы Своей, совершив Собою очищение грехов наших, воссел одесную (престола) величия на высоте,

verses.name: Евреям 1:4
verses.text: будучи столько превосходнее Ангелов, сколько славнейшее пред ними наследовал имя.

verses.name: Евреям 1:5
verses.text: Ибо кому когда из Ангелов сказал Бог: Ты Сын Мой, Я ныне родил Тебя? И еще: Я буду Ему Отцем, и Он будет Мне Сыном?

verses.name: Евреям 1:6
verses.text: Также, когда вводит Первородного во вселенную, говорит: и да поклонятся Ему все Ангелы Божии.

verses.name: Евреям 1:7
verses.text: Об Ангелах сказано: Ты творишь Ангелами Своими духов и служителями Своими пламенеющий огонь.

verses.name: Евреям 1:8
verses.text: А о Сыне: престол Твой, Боже, в век века; жезл царствия Твоего — жезл правоты.

verses.name: Евреям 1:9
verses.text: Ты возлюбил правду и возненавидел беззаконие, посему помазал Тебя, Боже, Бог Твой елеем радости более соучастников Твоих.

verses.name: Евреям 1:10
verses.text: И: в начале Ты, Господи, основал землю, и небеса — дело рук Твоих;

verses.name: Евреям 1:11
verses.text: они погибнут, а Ты пребываешь; и все обветшают, как риза,

verses.name: Евреям 1:12
verses.text: и как одежду свернешь их, и изменятся; но Ты тот же, и лета Твои не кончатся.

verses.name: Евреям 1:13
verses.text: Кому когда из Ангелов сказал Бог: седи одесную Меня, доколе положу врагов Твоих в подножие ног Твоих?

verses.name: Евреям 1:14
verses.text: Не все ли они суть служебные духи, посылаемые на служение для тех, которые имеют наследовать спасение?
